text:
Dana H: Quick flag for BlueHarbor QBR prep
Omar noticed an overnight multi-route cost blipe28094embeds + small reranker + surge in concurrency. Need fast triage and numbers for the renewal deck.
Omar P: confirmed. spike window ~23:40-02:30 UTC. embeds ~2.6x, reranker tokens ~1.8x, concurrency burst from a marketing crawler hitting the app.
Lina K: are they on credits or metered? that'll shape the commercial ask.
Ben S: credits with a soft overage band. renewal in 6 weeks. this could hurt renewal sentiment if we don't present controls.
Dana H: action list: (1) identify sources (crawler vs job) (2) produce 30-day base vs persistent-spike vs mitigated scenarios (3) propose mitigations + enablement in QBR.
Omar P: looks like two things: a marketing crawl that hit public endpoints and an automated nightly full reindex that coincided. pinged their eng (ops@blueharbor.io).
Lina K: quick projection I can paste now:
```
Assumptions: baseline 100k embed units/day; reranker baseline 900k tokens/day
Event delta/night: +160k embed units + +250k tokens
Scenario Base (no-repeat): 30d = $29,000
Scenario Repeat (if nightly): 30d = $52,400
Scenario Mitigated (throttle + incremental + bot-block): 30d = $34,100
Suggested commercial: show Mitigated as default + offer 1-month retainer to cover spikes (~$8k)
```
Ben S: two mitigation options for slides: A) immediate: apply IP-based soft throttle + block known crawler UA; B) medium: require preflight for nightly reindex + enable incremental reindex; C) commercial: one-month credit buffer + SE runbook.
Dana H: include onboarding feedback: the quickstart didn't call out external crawlers or adding UA/IP safeguards. add a tiny appendix: "public endpoint hardening + cost patterns".
Omar P: can spend-bot create alerts at 60% and 90% of monthly credits and notify CS + customer ops?
spend-bot: alert created blueharbor-60pct (notify: customer-success@redwood, ops@blueharbor.io), blueharbor-90pct (pager: oncall-billing), webhook -> #customer-success. thresholds 60%, 90%.
Lina K: i'll add a waterfall slide (base / accidental / mitigated) and include per-1k unit cost so AE can speak to ROI of retainer.
Ben S: enablement ask: 30-min runbook covering 1) blocking crawlers (IP/UA), 2) embedding cache + TTL, 3) incremental reindex & backfill window, 4) preflight checklist for heavy jobs.
Dana H: owners: Omar = confirm root causes & get exact timestamps; Lina = numbers + slides; Ben = draft enablement agenda; Dana = commercial ask (retainer sizing).
Omar P: reached ops@blueharbor.io
they replied: "thanks, disabling the crawler endpoint and pausing the reindex now. will confirm when paused."
Lina K: if they pause tonight i'll recalc the "mitigated" line and show delta in the QBR.
Ben S: i'll draft the runbook and propose a 30-min slot for next week.
Dana H: quick ask: can someone own follow-up with the AM to include the retainer proposal in renewal notes before EOD?
Omar P: i'll own AM follow-up and confirm paused jobs + timing. will update here. :thumbsup:
